briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies US-China AGI race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid record funding. Geopolitical tensions drive compute nationalism while prompt injection attacks surge in production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with multimodal reasoning; Anthropic countered with Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-V3.5 closed capability gap. Google Gemini 3 and xAI Grok-3 now in limited beta.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC began 2nm volume production for AI chips. Microsoft and Oracle announced $40B joint hyperscale buildout in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models surpass closed frontier performance before 2027?
